EXECUTIVE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT
This Executive Employment Agreement is entered into on 01 April 2026 between Acme Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Employer) and Rahul Mehta (Employee). Jurisdiction: Laws of India, Bengaluru, Karnataka.
1.0 Definitions & Engagement. The Employee shall serve as Principal Systems Engineer.
2.0 Compensation & Benefits. Base salary shall be INR 45,00,000 per annum, paid monthly on the last working day.

3.0 Confidentiality & Non-Compete. The Employee agrees not to disclose any Proprietary Information during or after employment.
Furthermore, for a period of 12 months following termination, the Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in competitive business within Bengaluru, Karnataka.

4.0 Term & Termination. Either party may terminate this agreement by providing a 90-day prior written notice.
In case of immediate termination without cause, the Employer shall pay 3 months of salary in lieu of notice. The agreement expires on 31 March 2029 unless renewed in writing.
